query:
INSERT INTO keynote_speakers (full_name, title, affiliation, presentation_title, bio, photo_url, display_order, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  'Prof. Dr. Ibrahim M. El-Sherbiny',
  'Acting President, University of Science and Technology',
  'Zewail City of Science and Technology',
  'Basic Sciences As the Foundation of Innovation: Some Success Stories for Disease Treatment and Advanced Biomedical Applications',
  'Dr. Ibrahim M. El-Sherbiny is a Tenured Professor of Nanotechnology and Nanomedicine, and Acting President of the University of Science and Technology at Zewail City. His H-index is 49 with about 10,000 citations. He has received over 70 national and international awards, including the Order of Egyptian Republic in Science and Arts. His research focuses on smart nano- and nano-in-micro matrices for biotechnological, pharmaceutical and biomedical applications.',
  '/images/speakers/dr-elsherbiny.png',
  2,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);
